options.player_question: How do I stay alive out here?
options.npc_answer: Here's a map. This may save you.

options.player_question: Any way to get around faster?
options.npc_answer: Exxoil left keys in all their jeeps. Same ignition. Corporate cost-cutting. Try these—they might work.

options.player_question: The tool here looks like garbage!
options.npc_answer: The main engineer of the island built everything from blueprints. You can scavenge for them or use old books and zines. I have one, take it...

options.player_question: How can I craft something around here?
options.npc_answer: You can find some magazines around and make some works.

options.player_question: Is there any way to communicate around?
options.npc_answer: Use your mobile and check the radio! I think some people are still alive.
